name: PCA Peel
lead: PCA Peel is a line of professional chemical peels sold by the skincare company PCA Skin. According to a summary of the company's own materials, the brand was founded in 1990 and in 2017 Colgate-Palmolive announced it would acquire PCA Skin, a deal completed in January 2018.[1]

The flagship product is described by the company as a modified, enhanced Jessner's peel combining lactic, salicylic, kojic and citric acids with resorcinol, marketed as self-neutralizing, with TCA-and-lactic-acid blends in the wider range.[1] The entry in this wiki was added as a branded TCA, lactic and salicylic peel.

The company's claims (such as being the leading peel brand among estheticians and more than one million peels performed yearly) come from its own materials and have not been independently verified in the sources reviewed.[1] No independent clinical studies of the PCA Peel were found.
infobox: Lactic, salicylic, kojic, citric acids; resorcinol; TCA blends in range

paras: The company says its peels exfoliate, stimulate collagen and address fine lines, hyperpigmentation, acne and some sensitive-skin conditions with minimal downtime.[1] It states formulas are developed in-house by a PhD chemist and tested clinically, though no specific studies are cited in the source summary.[1]

The same source notes a low aggregate consumer rating on one review site from a small number of reviews, citing irritation, burning and peeling, alongside a few reviews praising results.[1] Small review samples are not representative research.

No studies found. A search of ClinicalTrials.gov returned a 2016 registered trial of cosmeceutical therapy alongside facial rejuvenation procedures (NCT02726451, 20 participants, completed), but it is not clearly a study of the PCA Peel.[2]

timeline.event: Colgate-Palmolive completes acquisition of PCA Skin.[1]

card.summary: A branded professional peel line from PCA Skin; manufacturer claims are not backed by independent published trials.
card.note: Most information comes from the company's own materials.

quick.overview:
PCA Peel is a brand of professional chemical peels from PCA Skin, owned by Colgate-Palmolive since 2018. Its signature peel is described as a modified Jessner's formula.

The company reports clinical testing but no independent published trials were found.
quick.mechanism: Acid blends cause controlled superficial exfoliation, according to the company.
quick.risks: Peels in general can cause irritation, burning and peeling; consumer reviews cited in one source mention these.
